title: 第1705章 幽冥化鬼大法第1704章 幽冥大天地
lines: “比万魔界还要强么？轩辕道友若是如此，孟师妹恐怕无法与你们同往了。”
齐子儒尊摇了摇头，竟是直接拒绝。
倒是那位孟仙子神色没有太多变化，似乎一切都听从其师兄的意思。
王扶听了几人之话，脸上也露出几分惊疑，但见崔冥一副胸有成竹的模样，便并不打算开口，而是继续听下去。
“齐兄不必着急，本皇与崔道友既然有此决定，自然是有一些把握的。本皇虽对大乘之境渴望非常，但对于身家性命还是更加看重，毕竟本皇的下一次法则之劫，并不难渡过，便是第七次法则之劫，有玄天鼎，也不是什么难事。”轩辕圣皇却是一笑，神色平静。
“哦？既如此，轩辕道友便好生说道说道吧。不然，诸位道友进入幽冥界后，若是一个不幸，遇见幽冥界的冥祖，诸位能活下来的希望恐怕不足一成。更别说幽冥界中，必然也有不计其数的冥族、鬼族修士，若是深入其中，呵呵……焉有命在？”齐子儒尊看着轩辕圣皇，没有半分客气的说道。
“本皇虽自诩修为不俗，但也不敢说能从大乘境手中逃得性命。本皇召集几位，自然有法子解决此事，诸位应该知晓，崔道友所修乃鬼道一脉，与幽冥界不谋而合，而崔道友有一秘法，正好可以将我等气息掩盖，并演化成鬼族生灵。如此，进入幽冥界，便可万无一失。”轩辕圣皇不紧不慢地说道。
“化作鬼族生灵？崔道友当真有这等秘法……即便如此，又如何保证不会被幽冥界的大乘冥祖看出端倪？据齐某看来，崔道友的修为虽距离合体大圆满只差半步，但终究是差了半步，遇见幽冥界合体大圆满的冥族，恐怕都不一定能完全瞒过探察吧。”齐子儒尊看向一旁的干瘦老者，目中带着怀疑。
王扶听闻此话，也顺势看向这位鬼尊。
崔冥并未恼怒，反而嘿嘿一笑：
“齐道友的怀疑不无道理，老夫说再多也无济于事，轩辕道友不妨演示一二。”
“你这老鬼。”轩辕圣皇见此，不觉笑骂一声。
但一番摇头之后，手中捏诀，却是捏起了一道极其复杂的印诀，甚至用了数息时间才在掌中凝聚一道漆黑如墨的灵印。
接着，他又翻手露出一枚黑色宝珠。
手指一碾，宝珠破碎，厅中顿时阴风阵阵，隐隐有鬼哭狼嚎之声传来。
却见那宝珠碎裂之后，竟是露出一只墨绿色小鬼模样的生灵。
“这是……浮生鬼？”游煌柳眉一动，不觉喃喃一声。
可在场修士均有着尊者以上的神通，哪怕此声细若蚊蝇，也听得清清楚楚。
王扶眉头一紧，好似在什么地方瞧见过这“浮生鬼”的介绍。
“嘿嘿，不愧是羽族三大皇族之中的金鹏族，不错此物正是浮生鬼，还是老夫当初在星海偶然擒获，这么多年来，老夫参悟我崔家的神通，结合此鬼，这才创出这‘幽冥化鬼大法’。”崔冥咧嘴一笑，神色自傲。
“妾身与白鸦族关系不错，这才认识此鬼界生灵。”游煌嫣然一笑说道。
听闻白鸦一族，王扶也不免心头微动，毕竟他早年间可习得白鸦真纹。
而这时他也终于想起这浮生鬼是何物了。
content_en:
"Is it stronger than the World of Ten Thousand Demons? If Fellow Daoist Xuanyuan is like this, Junior Sister Meng may not be able to go with you."
Ruzun Qi Zi shook his head and refused directly.
However, Fairy Meng's expression did not change much, and she seemed to obey her senior brother's wishes in everything.
Wang Fu listened to what a few people said, with a bit of surprise on his face, but seeing Cui Ming's confident look, he didn't intend to speak, but continued to listen.
"Brother Qi, there is no need to worry. Since the Emperor and Fellow Daoist Cui have made this decision, they are naturally somewhat certain. Although the Emperor longs for the Mahayana realm very much, he still values ​​his wealth and life more. After all, it is not difficult for me to survive the next calamity of the Law. Even the seventh calamity of the Law is not difficult with the Xuantian Cauldron." Holy Emperor Xuanyuan smiled and looked calm.
"Oh? In that case, fellow Taoist Xuanyuan should just talk about it. Otherwise, if all of you Taoists are unfortunate enough to meet the Ming ancestors in the Netherworld after entering the Netherworld, the hope of your survival may be less than 10%. Not to mention that there must be countless Nether Race and Ghost Clan monks in the Netherworld. If you go deep into it, haha... How can you have fate?" Qi Zi Ruzun looked at Holy Emperor Xuanyuan and said without any politeness.
"Although I claim to have good cultivation, I dare not say that I can escape from the hands of the Mahayana realm. If I gather a few people, I will naturally have a way to solve this matter. You should know that Cui Daoyou Cui is a lineage of ghosts, which coincides with the Netherworld. And Cui Daoyou has a secret method that can just cover up our auras and evolve into ghost creatures. In this way, entering the Netherworld will be foolproof." Holy Emperor Xuanyuan said unhurriedly.
"Transform into a ghost creature? Cui Daoyou really has such a secret method... Even so, how can we guarantee that the Mahayana Ancestor of the Netherworld will not find out the clues? According to Qi, although Cui Daoyou's cultivation is only half a step away from the perfection of integration, it is still half a step away. If he meets the Nether clan who has perfected the integration of the Netherworld, he may not be able to completely hide it from detection." Ruzun Qi Zi looked at the skinny old man aside, with suspicion in his eyes.
After Wang Fu heard this, he also looked at the Ghost Lord.
Cui Ming was not angry, but smiled:
"Fellow Daoist Qi's suspicion is not unreasonable. No matter how much I say, it won't help. Fellow Daoist Xuanyuan might as well demonstrate."
"You old ghost." Seeing this, Holy Emperor Xuanyuan laughed and cursed.
But after shaking his head, he kneaded an extremely complex seal in his hand. It even took him a few breaths to condense a spiritual seal as black as ink in his palm.
Then, he turned over his hand to reveal a black orb.
With a crush of his fingers, the orb shattered, and there was a sudden gloomy wind in the hall, and there was a faint sound of ghosts crying and wolves howling.
But after the orb shattered, a creature that looked like a dark green imp was revealed.
"Is this... a floating ghost?" You Huang raised his eyebrows and murmured unconsciously.
But the monks present all have magical powers above that of the Venerable, and even if the sound is as small as a mosquito or fly, they can still hear it clearly.
Wang Fu frowned, as if he had seen the introduction of this "Floating Ghost" somewhere.
"Hehe, it is indeed the Jinpeng clan among the three royal families of the Yu clan. Yes, this thing is the floating ghost. I accidentally captured it in the sea of ​​​​stars. Over the years, I have understood the magical power of my Cui family and combined it with this ghost to create this 'Netherworld Ghost Transformation Technique'." Cui Ming grinned, looking proud.
"I have a good relationship with the White Crow Clan, so I got to know this creature from the ghost world." You Huang said with a sweet smile.
When Wang Fu heard about the White Crow clan, he couldn't help but feel a little moved. After all, he could learn the White Crow True Pattern in his early years.
At this time, he finally remembered what this floating ghost was.
